prose.subject: Invoice INV-59819 and Updated Payout Details
prose.body:
Hi Omar,

I hope you are having a productive week. I am writing to share invoice INV-59819 for our recent services, totaling 5783.89 USDC. Please find the document attached for your records.

Additionally, I wanted to inform you of a minor administrative update on our side. Netherby Analytics has recently registered a new dedicated treasury account for our operations. This change is part of our ongoing effort to streamline our financial processing and ensure better segregation of duties. The new account identifier is netherbyanalytics19-treasury.testnet. We have linked this account directly to our verified domain, netherby-analytics.example, to maintain transparency and security for all future transactions.

Please update your payment records to reflect this new account number for any subsequent invoices. For this specific invoice, you may continue using the previously established details unless you prefer to test the new routing. Let me know if you have any questions regarding the transition or the invoice items listed. I am happy to provide a quick call if you need to discuss the breakdown of the costs in more detail.

Thank you for your continued partnership. We value the collaboration between Corvane Labs and our team.

Best regards,

Lena Varga
Netherby Analytics
